review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, self-review before implementation; not independent approval
review.decision: Implement the user's explicit historical-project cleanup and remaining doctor, backup and browser-loader fixes
review.notes: Read-only inventory found about981MiB of HQ records, including546MiB of full relay exports and314MiB of project evidence. Current core selection still admits structurally recognized relay exports with legacy names and exceeds128MiB. Keep unknown notes, explicit includes, full exports,128MiB import limits and all recovery materials protected. Doctor must identify actionable project material without deleting, rebinding or claiming an inactive client retries. Existing one-second bridge heartbeat and bounded initial publication retry remain producer-owned. Web currently pulses only one square; match the accepted App100-unit pane geometry and1.8s top-right/bottom/top-left focus cycle with live reduced motion. Browser plugin is absent; existing hosted Playwright validates actual rendering without local dependency/cache work. Operator cleanup separately uses a private project archive, bounded same-volume moves, a synthetic helper fixture and complete streamed archive/SHA readback before removing source copies; no production import/session restart or automatic deletion is authorized by running doctor.

cases.description: Automatic core recovery recognizes legacy full relay observations while preserving unknown notes and explicit includes
cases.setup: Synthetic HQ tree with current and legacy export filenames, real-shaped nonempty relay request arrays, ordinary structured notes, malformed/partial/empty arrays and an include override; no production records.
cases.action: Select core and full archive scopes, round-trip an included observation and inspect retained file content.
cases.expected: Only recognized generated observations leave the automatic core scope; included observations and all full-export records remain. Unknown or corrupt notes remain protected and may still cause an honest limit failure. Restore limits stay128MiB/32MiB/10000; no file is moved or deleted.

cases.description: Doctor distinguishes historical project payloads from core HQ records and explains recovery limits without destructive fixes
cases.setup: Isolated HQ containing declared project reports/attachments, recognized full relay exports, small ordinary notes, core knowledge/workspace and protected recovery points.
cases.action: Read the storage diagnostic projection and render both doctor languages; repeat the read and compare the original tree.
cases.expected: Report bounded category counts/bytes and a clear project-archive recommendation.128MiB is described as recovery-package safety, distinct from directory size and configured snapshot budget. Unknown files are not declared disposable. Doctor and doctor fix do not migrate/delete materials or modify backup policy.

cases.description: Conversation diagnostics never promise retries from a stopped or unverified producer
cases.setup: Synthetic resume/frontend records and injected process observations: missing frontend, stale proof with original bridge absent/replaced, stale original bridge present, current verified frontend and identity conflict.
cases.action: Read value-free recovery evidence and render doctor guidance in English and Chinese.
cases.expected: Stopped and unknown producers get accurate normal-resume or verification guidance; stale-live evidence is not presented as proof of an active retry. Healthy exact current ownership remains healthy. No session input, RPC resend, forced binding, history timestamp inference or state write occurs.

cases.description: Browser branded loaders match the accepted App pane geometry and moving cyan focus across desktop/narrow viewports and both themes
cases.setup: Real served Web app over the existing isolated HTTP fixture, widths390/1440, light/dark themes, held data responses; no real pairing or user data.
cases.action: Open the actual loading view, inspect running CSS animations, seek the three cycle phases and capture rendered states at fixed phases.
cases.expected: The three fixed rounded panes keep their bounds while the cyan focus moves top-right to bottom to top-left over1.8s. Whole-mark breathing and an indefinitely single lit pane fail. Label and geometry remain readable at both widths/themes, with no page or console errors.

cases.description: Browser loading honors live reduced motion without repeated accessibility announcements
cases.setup: Real pending browser view with reduced-motion emulation and the same shared branded loader.
cases.action: Toggle reduced motion during the read, inspect animation state and the accessibility/DOM structure, then resolve the read.
cases.expected: Reduced motion keeps a static top-right cyan pane with no running focus cycle. Decorative panes are hidden from accessibility; one localized loading status remains. The loader and its focus animations disappear on completion, with no artificial delay or layout jump.

cases.description: Shared browser loading entries preserve their original read lifecycle and input boundary
cases.setup: Existing synthetic pane, transcript and panes-list endpoints with deferred response bodies; narrow focus and desktop tile paths.
cases.action: Exercise terminal/chat or panes-list loading, switch views while a read is held, complete the current read and inspect current content.
cases.expected: All branded loading entries use the common three-pane cycle. Late replies cannot restore a retired loader or overwrite the selected view. Failed and successful-empty reads keep their existing meanings; no send/retry of task input is generated.
